about: Questions about this repo whose answer is one function. Used for graph search recall (internal/graph tests) and for the agent A/B test (scripts/graph-ab.sh). The 'symbol' and 'file' fields are the ground truth.

queries.q: Which function rejects cross-origin POST requests to the harness API (CSRF protection)?
Where are frame-blocking headers like X-Frame-Options removed from proxied tool responses?
Which function decides whether a learner gets promoted to the next level?
Where is the seeded train/test split of eval tasks computed?
Which function runs model-written JavaScript in the Code Mode sandbox?
Where is the system prompt assembled and its version hash computed?
How is the dollar cost of an LLM call computed from token usage?
Which function checks that a list of hosts is loopback only?
What turns cost events into budget-alert events when a spending threshold is crossed?
Where is the rule that decides if a candidate harness version beats the base version?
